text.div: Patient Document generated by Health Intersections Patient Health Document Generator

My life has been really hard lately. My boyfriend left me, my parents got divorced, and I've been struggling with alcohol and drug use to cope. I was recently diagnosed with bipolar disorder and hepatitis C. I have severe anxiety and sometimes can't leave my house. I know I need help but I'm scared and don't trust easily. I want to get clean and healthy but I don't know how. I used to love art and want to get back to that someday.

Patient's Goals

  • Achieve sobriety and maintain recovery
  • Stabilize bipolar disorder with medication
  • Treat hepatitis C infection
  • Develop healthy coping strategies for anxiety
